title: Regression suite for the edit-preserve block (S2-01)

input.requestedOutcome: A data-driven regression suite for bkV2CommitBooking's edit-preserve block (allotment_v2.html ~:76868-76956) proving each of the 15 fields it must carry from `editing` onto the rebuilt `newBk` (history, weatherResolve, rebook, invoiceId, paymentStatus, ops, b2cOverride, upgrades, feeItems, reschedule, partialCancels, cancellation, cancelCategory, resolved approval, decided focApproval) really does, sourced live from the app file so a future deleted carry-over line fails the matching test.
acceptanceCriteria: One test per carry-over field, generated from a single data-driven list (not hand-written per field)
Deleting a carry-over line from allotment_v2.html makes the suite go red for that field — proven, not just asserted
Add only the delta beyond LAM-77's tests/legacy/edit-preserve.test.mjs (origin/main), and state the overlap explicitly
Reuse the existing LAM-22 test/ harness conventions (node:test, no framework) rather than introducing a new one
constraints: Do NOT edit allotment_v2/allotment_v2.html — read only
Do NOT edit test/helpers/**, test/fixtures/**, or root package.json — declare as a dependency instead if needed
Stage only owned paths with git add -- <path>, never git add . / -A
No Postgres/prod reachable from this sandbox — report those checks as blocked/not_run, never fabricate results
assumptions: Worktree was clean at e7d28f0 before any edit (verified via git status --short --branch)
tests/legacy/** (LAM-77) does not exist on refactor/booking-v2-migration — read via `git show origin/main:...` only, never checked out
allotment_v2/docs/workflows/01-booking-lifecycle.md already existed on this branch and documents the same block at the same rough line range

output.summary: Added test/regression/edit-preserve/ (fields.mjs's single CARRY_OVER_FIELDS list + lib/source.mjs + lib/sandbox.mjs + edit-preserve.test.mjs), a node:test suite that extracts each of the 15 required carry-over fields' real marker line(s) straight out of allotment_v2.html at run time and executes them in an isolated vm sandbox, generating one present-case and one absent-case test per field (31 tests total) from that single list. Proved live — twice, on two different fields (ops and b2cOverride) — that deleting the real carry-over line in a scratch copy of the file (never the tracked file) turns exactly that field's two tests red and nothing else, then restoring returns the suite to green. allotment_v2.html itself was never modified (git diff --stat empty throughout).

filesChanged.purpose: The single data-driven CARRY_OVER_FIELDS list (15 fields: marker text, present/absent fixtures, assertions) the test suite is generated from

Reads allotment_v2.html (default: tracked file; override via EDIT_PRESERVE_HTML_PATH) and extracts literal marker text (extractLine/extractBetween), throwing a field-named error when a marker is missing/non-unique
Thin node:vm wrapper that runs an extracted code snippet and returns its exported function
node:test suite generated from CARRY_OVER_FIELDS — one present-case + one absent-case test per field, plus a field-list coverage check against the ticket's named list

No Postgres or prod service reachable from this sandbox, and this task's change touches no server/DB code, so nothing here needs it — recorded as blocked/not-applicable rather than skipped silently.

decisions: Built this task's own lib/source.mjs and lib/sandbox.mjs under the owned test/regression/edit-preserve/lib/ rather than reusing LAM-77's tests/legacy/lib/, which does not exist on refactor/booking-v2-migration and lives outside this task's owned paths on origin/main; followed the same literal-marker-extraction pattern LAM-77 established for consistency.

Extracted each carry-over field at the smallest self-contained unit of source (a single statement for 12 of 15 fields) instead of LAM-77's 3 larger grouped sub-blocks, so 'one test per field' means deleting any one carry-over line invalidates exactly that field's test(s) and no others — proven for ops and b2cOverride.

For b2cOverride and resolved approval, both real else-if branches of an earlier condition outside the extracted span, prefixed the extracted text with a `if(false){` stub to run them standalone and always reach the else branch — this characterizes the exact non-B2C-diff / non-fresh-approval-request carry-over the ticket names, without pulling in the separate B2C merge/diff or over-capacity-approval logic that shares the same if/else.

Ran the mutation (delete-line) proof only against a scratch copy of allotment_v2.html outside the repo (via EDIT_PRESERVE_HTML_PATH), never against the tracked file, per the explicit 'read only, never edit' constraint on allotment_v2.html — even a temporarily-deleted-then-restored edit would violate that.

Did not add a permanent in-suite mutation self-test (programmatically stripping markers on every CI run) — treated the ticket's ask as a one-time proof to capture as verification evidence; assertUnique's field-named error already makes any future accidental line loss in the real file surface immediately and specifically the next time this suite runs.
risks: Extraction depends on exact marker text (whitespace/quote style) matching allotment_v2.html verbatim — a pure reformat (e.g. Prettier) with no behavior change would false-fail these tests, the same trade-off LAM-77 already accepted.

b2cOverride's test covers only the non-B2C carry-over (else) path; the B2C merge/diff branch above it (bkV2B2CDiff, _b2cSnap) is separate and not covered here — flagged as a follow-up, not assumed correct.

test/e2e/booking-write-path.test.mjs and test/helpers/db.mjs fail outright (not skip) under `node --test <dir>` on this Windows/Node 24 sandbox — pre-existing and outside this task's scope, not fixed here.
dependencies: allotment_v2/docs/workflows/01-booking-lifecycle.md staying accurate about the edit-preserve block's location for future orientation (tests themselves depend only on marker text, not the doc)

The LAM-22 test harness convention (node:test, no framework dependency) and its existing node --test step in .github/workflows/tests.yml, which discovers this suite automatically — no package.json change requested
followUps: Extend CARRY_OVER_FIELDS (or add a sibling suite) to cover the B2C merge/diff branch of the edit-preserve block (bkV2IsB2CBk(editing) true path: total, priceBreakdown, priceMode, manualTotal, trips, passengers, addOns) — related to but distinct from b2cOverride itself.

Consider reconciling this suite with LAM-77's tests/legacy/edit-preserve.test.mjs once both branches converge on the same target — they currently overlap on 12 of 15 fields at different granularity (LAM-77: 3 grouped tests; this suite: 15x2 single-field tests) and this suite adds 3 fields LAM-77 does not cover (b2cOverride, resolved approval, decided focApproval).
rollback: Purely additive test files with no runtime/schema/server dependency. `git rm -r test/regression/edit-preserve docs/development/tasks/LAM-25.md .agent-reports/LAM-25.json` on this branch, or simply do not merge the PR.
